information: ![GLC 2026 Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5NDM1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a86a490f68115ce466f841046c49054e0f69caa/GLC26Logo.png) ![Partnered organizations' logos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5NzM2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7b0f0ed544f3ae9a0ca829fe38f97bd9d2f0cc6c/ghYzBXw.png) This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* and *[CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/)* as the Great Lakes Regional Championship of 2026. Competitors from Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and Wisconsin are eligible for the title of Great Lakes Champion.
